segments.text: It's because of the 1986 law, and it has to do with legal accountability.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: For medications other than vaccines, manufacturers can be sued if their product causes harm.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: The legal accountability creates a strong incentive to thoroughly test for safety, but vaccines, because of the 1986 law, are treated very differently.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: Starting in 1986, if you are injured by a vaccine, you cannot sue the manufacturer.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: Why was this law passed?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: At that time, vaccine manufacturers were facing exploding injury payouts in the billions of dollars.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: Some companies left the market.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: Others warned they might stop producing vaccines altogether.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: There was concern about a potential shortage of vaccines.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: The argument was, quote, we had to stabilize the vaccine supply.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: Rather than force vaccine makers to produce safe products, this law instead created a program called the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program that would pay people injured by vaccines.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: As a result, vaccine makers today test vaccines to a safety standard that is far lower than for other medications.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: It's time to repeal this law.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: If a medication is truly safe and effective, it does not need special protection against civil lawsuits.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: It's urgent because every day this law remains in place, millions of children continue to be given vaccines that are held to a far lower safety standard than other medications.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06

segments.text: Please, add your name today and become a part of the movement demanding the same standard of safety testing for vaccines as for all other medications.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_06
